criteria_location: Policy: Commercial, pp.1-2. Prior authorization by product table p.3. No separate evidence section beyond a short description.
procedures_covered: Lower eyelid blepharoplasty 15820, 15821 (cosmetic unless conjunctival irritation)

logic.top_level: pathways: children <=9; children >9 and adults (ANY of four conditions); blepharoplasty ALL; blepharoptosis ALL; brow lift ALL (single bullet)

k_of_n.quote: Upper eyelid blepharoplasty or blepharoptosis repair is considered MEDICALLY NECESSARY for ANY of the following conditions: Difficulty tolerating a prosthesis ...; Repair of a functional defect caused by trauma, tumor or surgery; Periorbital sequelae of thyroid disease; Nerve palsy

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Closing 'Not Medically Necessary' (criteria not met), 'Cosmetic and Not Medically Necessary' (appearance absent functional signs; lower lid not meeting conjunctival irritation criteria) and 'Reconstructive' definition paragraphs. No contraindication list.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Upper field must improve by at least 20 degrees with eyelid taped compared to visual field with untaped lid, OR visual field obstruction by lid or brow must limit upper field to within 30 degrees of fixation.
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: An OR inside an ALL list; two different tests (improvement >= 20 degrees OR absolute field <= 30 degrees). Repeated verbatim in three procedures. 'by lid or brow' means the same sentence serves blepharoplasty, ptosis and brow lift without distinguishing the source.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: There is either redundant skin overhanging the upper eyelid margin and resting on the eyelashes or significant dermatitis on the upper eyelid caused by redundant tissue, AND
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'either ... and ... or' nesting inside criterion 2; 'significant' undefined.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Upper eyelid blepharoplasty or blepharoptosis repair is considered MEDICALLY NECESSARY for ANY of the following conditions
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Applies to two different procedures at once; and unlike the sections below, no vision/field criterion is required for these conditions.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Brow lift ... when ALL of the following criteria are met: • Upper field must improve ...

requirement_kinds.quote: Individual is less than or equal to 9 years of age
intended to relieve obstruction of central vision which, in the judgment of the treating physician, is severe enough to produce occlusion amblyopia
Difficulty tolerating a prosthesis in an anophthalmic socket; trauma, tumor or surgery; thyroid sequelae; nerve palsy
Documented complaints of interference with vision or visual field-related activities such as difficulty reading or driving
redundant skin overhanging the upper eyelid margin and resting on the eyelashes or significant dermatitis
Upper field must improve by at least 20 degrees with eyelid taped ... OR ... limit upper field to within 30 degrees of fixation
Lower lid blepharoplasty that does not meet the above conjunctival irritation criteria is considered cosmetic
the individual must meet the criteria for each procedure
Commercial Managed Care (HMO and POS): Prior authorization is required; PPO and Indemnity: not required

extraction_hazards: Numbered lists within lists and 'AND'/'OR' trailing; the 'either ... or' sentence is wrapped.
Page footers are single page digits.
ICD-10-PCS table could be mistaken for diagnosis codes.
Policy has no printed effective date (extraction metadata empty).
interesting_structures: Age-banded pathways: <= 9 years (amblyopia risk) vs > 9 and adults.
Photographs not required (removed 12/2015: 'Photograph requirements for blepharoplasty removed').
Prior authorization varies by product (HMO/POS requires, PPO/Indemnity does not).
Visual-field alternative: improvement >= 20 degrees OR absolute limit <= 30 degrees.

fit_to_tree.why: Short, tidy any/all. The OR embedded in an ALL list and the age-banded pathways are the only structure.
